description:
FILED s530b (Opus agent, 2026-10-31), from the Template-Toolkit re-census (after #4080 / #4081 / #4082).  PRE-EXISTING.  LOUD (a drop; a run-time die when reached).

    package F; sub AUTOLOAD { our $AUTOLOAD; my $n = $AUTOLOAD; $n =~ s/.*:://; return if $n eq 'DESTROY'; "$n(" . join(",", @_[1..$#_]) . ")" }
    package main; my $f = bless {}, 'F'; my @a = (0..5);
    my $s = sub { $f->if(@a[2, 4, 5]) };  print $s->(), "\n";
    print $f->foreach(1, 2), " ", $f->while(3), " ", $f->unless(4), " ", $f->until(5), "\n";
perl: if(2,4,5) / foreach(1,2) while(3) unless(4) until(5).  PCL: `PCL: statement dropped at ... $f->if(@a[2, 4, 5]) -- Can't call method "content" on an undefined value`; the print statement is split as `foreach ((1, 2), ...) { print $f->; }` and dropped.  `$f->return(6)`, `->next`, `->last`, `->use`, `->default`, `->switch`, `->try`, `->else`, `->elsif` are FINE (not modifier words).
Scratch probe: scratch/s530b/p/kw.pl.

CAUSE: the statement-MODIFIER split takes the first top-level Word whose CONTENT is if/unless/while/until/for/foreach -- never asking whether it follows `->`, where perl (toke.c: a word after `->` is a method name, XOPERATOR) never reads a keyword.  The test is spelled in ~10 places by content (Pl/Parser.pm 520 2595 2706 2995 3813; Pl/Parser2.pm 6842 7004 11708 14155 14186; Pl/VarAnnotator.pm 183 -- `Pl::PExpr::Config::is_statement_modifier($content)` or an inline regex), so the fix is ONE token-level predicate (a modifier Word is not preceded by an `->` Operator) that every site asks -- rule 11, count the parse paths.  ALSO: the vendored PPI structures `$f->if(1)`'s parenthesis as PPI::Structure::Condition (a List for `->foreach(`), which PCL's method-call lowering may not take -- probe after the split is fixed; if it is still wrong it is a PPI Lexer row (the s527 branch's territory: a word after `->` is a method name).
ROWS: every Template-Toolkit template with [% IF %] / [% FOREACH %] / [% WHILE %] (Grammar.pm rules 44, 57, ...); not fixed in s530b (filler budget: three).
=== DONE (s531c, 2026-11-01): the PCL half; the paren half is PPI's -> #4201 ===
FIXED (commit 4f823e44): ONE token predicate `Pl::PExpr::Config::is_statement_modifier_word($tok)` -- a Word whose content is one of the six AND whose previous significant sibling is not the `->` Operator AND whose next is not `=>` (toke.c: a word after `->` is a method name, XOPERATOR; a word before `=>` is a string) -- asked by all twelve modifier-split sites (Parser.pm _desugar_loop_modifiers, _process_expression_statement, _process_variable_statement in-sub `my`, _process_our_declaration, _split_trailing_modifier; Parser2.pm _word_in_operator_position, _local_value_consumed's separator, _stmt_modifier_split, _is_bare_loop_control, the `return if` arm of _lower_stmt, _split_modifier, _decl_loop_modifier; VarAnnotator's append-rest decline).  The string-keyed Config::is_statement_modifier stays for the one name-only caller (`our sub if` in _rename_lexical_subs).
Probes (scratch/s531c/p/kw*.pl), = perl: `$f->foreach(...)`, `$f->for(...)`, the paren-less `$f->if` / `->while` / `->unless` / `->until`, a method then a REAL modifier, the real modifiers untouched (if / unless / for / foreach / while / until / do-while), class methods, inside map / an anon sub / a sub's `my ... if`, `our $o = $f->for(8)`, `return $f->until`, `push @p, if => 5` and `my @b = (1), while => 2;` (the latter was an ENDLESS LOOP on the base), `$h{while}`, `main::if(2)`.  NOT this mechanism, filed: #4202 (`&unless(5)` refused by ExprToCL's keyword guard).
THE PAREN HALF: `$f->if(...)` / `->while(` / `->unless(` / `->until(` / `->elsif(` still drop -- PPI's `_round` builds that parenthesis as a Structure::Condition -> #4201 (measured: a scratch copy with `_round` patched + this tree = perl on every probe and on the whole TT set below).
Template::Grammar.pm (`./pl2cl --module`): 8 drops -> 6 (the two `->foreach` rules; the 6 left are `->if` x4 / `->while` x2 = #4201).
BOARD (one-file runs of the 32 TT files citing #4083, scratch/s531c/b1/tt/, compared BY DESCRIPTION -- a test whose process stops failing shifts the row numbers; scratch/s531c/ttcmp2.pl): of the 316 blessed #4083 rows, 157 PASS and left baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv by edit; 153 still fail and pass with the PPI patch -> re-caused to #4201 (incl. the context.t / provider.t *PLAN* rows); 4 fail the same with the PPI patch -> re-caused by diagnosis (compile2.t 10-13 = #1688, the compiled .ttc read back as 1; include.t 33 = #4086, the template-name quotes); 5 rows that run only now, with a new failing description, re-caused on their own cause (compile1.t 9 / compile3.t 11 / compile4.t 7 = #4086, the META quotes; table.t 5 / 9 = #4205, NEW: an anon array constructor flattens a nested list one level).  Files now fully passing in a one-file run: datafile format grammar-factory list macro tags throw varsv1 vmethods/hash wrapper.
Guard: Pl/t/method-modifier-name-01.t (9 rows; 8 fail on ade297e7, the two controls pass).
subject: A METHOD named like a statement modifier (`$f->if(...)`, `$f->foreach(...)`, `->while`, `->unless`, `->until`, `->for`) is split as `STATEMENT MODIFIER LIST` -- the statement is DROPPED; Template::Grammar's IF / FOREACH / WHILE rules ($factory->if / ->foreach / ->while)
